fire: The old soldier sat by the window, his palsied hands trembling over the cup of tea.
In the parable, the friends lowered the palsied man through the roof to reach the healer.
Archaeologists say the treasure lay buried under the chapel floor for three centuries.
She wrote that the letter had been buried in a drawer beneath old tax receipts.
His palsied fingers could no longer fasten the buttons on his winter coat.
The dog had buried the bone so deep that even he could not find it again.
Buried beneath the snow, the old fence posts only reappeared in late April.
The poem describes a palsied king who still insists on riding out to war.
